gripOrHq.title: All-Nighter
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

gripOrHq.title: The Short Circuit
gripOrHq.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Top Runners' Conference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

heapOrArchives.title: R&D Interface
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Top Runners' Conference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: Zetatech Software Installer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Deep Thought
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Thought counter. Three or more Thought counters allow you to look at the top card of R&D at the start of each of your turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: Rigged Investments
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

rig.title: Silicon Saloon Franchise
rig.rulesText: A: Gain [1] and draw one card.

rig.title: Crash Everett, Inventive Fixer
rig.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards from your stack, draw an extra card; then choose one of the cards drawn and either trash it or return it to the top of your stack. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

ice.title: Zombie
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Dieter Esslin
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Dieter Esslin, Dieter does 1 Net damage.

root.title: Data Masons
root.rulesText: Cost to rez walls is reduced by [2]. All walls have +1 strength.
